values.title: Our Mission
values.description: Give every serious student — regardless of school background — a shot at a top JEE/NEET rank through clarity, mentorship, and disciplined weekly cycles.

values.title: Our Belief
values.description: Coaching isn't magic. It's the compounding of small, honest habits — daily problem sets, weekly tests, and a mentor who won't let you drift.

values.title: The Founders
values.description: Started in 2010 by a team of IITian educators who left corporate coaching chains to build something small, personal and unapologetically results-driven.

values.title: Results First
values.description: 3800+ students trained. 77% selection ratio in our Pinnacle batch. AIR 1833 in JEE Advanced 2025. Numbers we can defend, not hide behind.
